query: ALTER TABLE container_registry_repository_manifest ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_repository_manifest_chk_sha_digest CHECK(manifest_digest ~ '^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$'), ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_repository_manifest_fk_repository_id FOREIGN KEY(repository_id) REFERENCES container_registry_repository(id), ADD CONSTRAINT container_registry_repository_manifest_fk_manifest_digest FOREIGN KEY(manifest_digest) REFERENCES container_registry_manifest(digest);
